title: [BFC 26-061] - Report regarding amendment, which increases the total funding to LAFD,
text:
[4. CONSENT AGENDA ITEMS]
[BFC 26-061] - Report regarding amendment, which increases the total funding to LAFD,
  to the 2026 Regional Hazardous Materials Response (RHMR) Training Agreement
  #A261016460 with the Governor’s Office of Emergency Services.
  Recommendation: That the Board approve the report and adopt the recommendations
  therein.
